what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Haiti in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 26815 Haitian asylum seekers in Canada, 11.3% of all asylum seekers from Haiti.
Refugees from Haiti, a separate group, live mostly in Brazil, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Haiti in 2004, with FLRN and OP Lavalas, and again from 2024 to 2025 with Viv Ansanm.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, fall in the same period as the most recent conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 271 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
